bullets.title: DELL: Blowout Q2 — FY27 guide raised to $192B rev / $25.50 EPS on AI server surge
bullets.body: DELL Q2 revenue $47.0B beat consensus $44.9B; EPS $7.04 beat $4.91 est (+43%). AI server revenue $16.4B (+100% YoY); ISG operating margin 15% vs 11% est. FY27 guidance raised to $192B revenue (+69% YoY) and $25.50 EPS (+148% YoY) from prior $165-169B / $17.90; Q3 guide $49B / $6.50 EPS also well above Street. Full-year AI server forecast lifted to $74B (from $60B). Citi maintains Buy with $515 PT; Deutsche Bank initiated Hold at $480 despite the beat.

bullets.title: MDB: Q2 beat on EA strength; -12.6% AH as Atlas growth disappoints buyside
bullets.body: MDB Q2 revenue $771.8M (+30% YoY) beat consensus $735M; EPS $1.90 vs $1.62; operating margin expanded to 24% from 15% YoY; FCF nearly doubled to $137.6M. FY27 guidance raised $70M to $2.99-3.03B. However, Atlas growth of 29% missed buyside expectations of 30.5-31%, driving the -12.6% AH reaction. Citi maintains Buy with $545 PT, flagging Q3 Atlas trajectory as key watch.

bullets.title: CRDO: Beats Q1 but margins and guidance seen as light; -8.5% AH
bullets.body: CRDO Q1 revenue $479M (+115% YoY) beat consensus $473M, but operating margin 48.2% missed 49.3% expected. Q2 guide midpoint ~$530M slightly above Street $519.8M but below buyside hopes; optical upside flagged as potential source of estimate revision. Stock fell -8.5% AH per after-hours summary.

bullets.title: PANW: Q4 beat + raised FY27 guide; acquires AI platform Console
bullets.body: PANW Q4 revenue $3.41B beat $3.35B consensus; EPS $1.02 vs $0.98; NGS ARR +63% YoY to $9.10B, adding ~$1B in Q4 alone. FY27 revenue guided $14.10-14.20B vs Street $13.84B; EPS $4.16-4.19 vs $4.10; NGS ARR guide $11.075-11.175B. Company targets $20B NGS ARR by FY30 and 40% FCF margin by FY28. Separately acquired AI-native enterprise ops platform Console (terms undisclosed).

bullets.title: CRM: Wolfe upgrades to Outperform on Agentforce ARR >$200% YoY, outcome-based pricing
bullets.body: Wolfe Research upgrades CRM to Outperform citing Agentforce ARR of $1.5B (+>200% YoY), with 50% of Q2 bookings from customers buying additional credits. Slack had its best NNAOV quarter since acquisition; premium upgrades tripled since Slackbot launch. Outcome-based pricing expanding to sales/service; gross margin strategy leverages cheapest available models including open-source. Organic revenue growth 7-8% continuing to re-rate.

bullets.title: CRWD: Fal.Con 2026 — AIDR ARR tripled Q/Q; agentic security opportunity expanding
bullets.body: Raymond James bullish on CRWD post Fal.Con: AIDR ARR grew >250% in F1Q27 and nearly tripled Q/Q in F2Q27 with $50M+ pipeline. New Falcon Guardian capabilities secure autonomous AI agents; SafeMind adds offensive/defensive cyber models. Management targets $7B+ cash build and ~$4B FCF annuity in five years.

bullets.title: GS August sector sentiment: Software +11% vs NDX; AI/power trade under pressure
bullets.body: GS trading desk notes software outperformed NDX by >11% in back-to-back months driven by positioning and easing AI bear narratives. Key debate is whether application software can sustain gains — INTU/HUBS bears vs MSFT/CRM bulls. AI/power trade faces headwinds from data center policy developments in TX, PA, OH. CRM, TEAM, NOW, PSKY, DASH flagged overbought (14-day RSI); APP and GEV flagged oversold. GS Communacopia + Tech Conference 9/8-11 features NVDA, AVGO, MSFT CEO/CFO keynotes.

bullets.title: CHTR: CFO Fischer departing Oct 15; stock -4.1%
bullets.body: Charter Communications CFO Jessica Fischer stepping down effective October 15; Kevin Howard named interim CFO. Stock fell 4.1% on the news amid a broader market retreat driven by rising bond yields and oil.

bullets.title: FSLR: Tesla/SpaceX 100GW solar capacity build creates major supply/pricing headwind
bullets.body: Elon Musk announced Tesla and SpaceX each building 100 GW/yr of solar capacity, incremental to prior 100 GW plans, creating significant supply pressure and negative long-term pricing impact for FSLR per the sector summary.

bullets.title: VST: Bullish thesis on data center growth + LT contracting + buybacks intact
bullets.body: VST flagged as well-positioned for data center growth with solid long-term contracting thesis and attractive capital allocation including buybacks per the Power & Utilities sector summary.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Data center REITs lagging as 10yr rises 5bps to 4.79%
bullets.body: Data Center REIT subsector down 1.60% YTD and the worst-performing REIT category; EQIX specifically cited as weaker. Rising 10-year Treasury yield (+5bps to 4.79%) and global yield surge on Iran tensions and AI capex concerns pressuring valuations.

bullets.title: NVDA: August recap — +9.8% on blowout FY28 guide; Anthropic $35B compute deal with Lambda (NVDA-backed)
bullets.body: NVDA gained +9.8% in August after reporting 70% revenue growth guidance for FY28 (100% absent supply constraints), endorsing the AI capex theme broadly. Separately, Anthropic signed a $35B computing deal with Lambda cloud, a provider backed by NVDA; HUT is developing a related Texas data center.

bullets.title: PLTR: +51.5% in August on AI demand and US Commercial reacceleration
bullets.body: PLTR was the standout August performer at +51.5% on a healthy earnings beat with AI demand driving US Commercial segment reacceleration per the monthly recap.

bullets.title: MRVL: Beat and raised with GOOGL production agreement and ownership stake disclosure
bullets.body: MRVL beat and raised guidance in August with a disclosed production agreement and ownership stake from GOOGL, per the monthly US recap.

bullets.title: AVGO: JPM and UBS hosting investor events Sept 3 post-earnings
bullets.body: JPMorgan's Harlan Sur hosting an AVGO Ask-Me-Anything call Sept 3 at 10am ET; UBS hosting a Semis Earnings Recap call for AVGO same morning at 8:30am ET. AVGO CEO also keynoting GS Communacopia + Tech Conference Sept 8-11.

bullets.title: SHOP: -4.2% in Canadian trading; COO highlights 2x agentic commerce conversion
bullets.body: SHOP fell 4.2% alongside broader Canadian market weakness (TSX -1.20%). Separately, Shopify COO Jess Hertz highlighted that agent traffic using Shopify's catalog converts at 2x vs. scraped-data agents; 5 consecutive quarters of >30% growth with 90% of revenue from merchants on platform >1 year.

bullets.title: AAPL: Claims OpenAI destroying key evidence in trade secrets case
bullets.body: AAPL filed a new legal claim asserting OpenAI is destroying key evidence in an ongoing trade secrets dispute, per the end-of-day market summary. AAPL stock was up 2.6% in hardware-led trading despite broader tech weakness.

bullets.title: RBLX: Roth Capital launching proprietary cohort survey on user aging and bookings growth
bullets.body: Roth Capital initiating a proprietary n=1,000 survey tracking whether Roblox is aging up its user base and growing bookings per user, and assessing migration to competing platforms (Fortnite, Minecraft). Results could provide leading indicator on monetization trajectory.

bullets.title: GEV: Flagged oversold on RSI; SpaceX turbine blade entry a debate topic
bullets.body: GEV flagged as oversold per 14-day RSI in GS's August sector sentiment note. Jefferies hosting a Sept 8 webinar debating gas turbine supply chain implications of SpaceX expanding into blade casting, with GEV explicitly in scope.

bullets.title: ACN: EU clears acquisition of majority stake in UniCredit tech JV VTS
bullets.body: EU approved Accenture's acquisition of 51% of VTS S.p.A from IBM Italia and 9% from UniCredit under simplified merger review. VTS manages a significant portion of UniCredit's technology infrastructure. Deal was originally announced July 31, 2026.
